name: gitlab
description: GitLab CI (gitlab.com or your own server): one MaximizePM stage for each GitLab stage; reads the jobs of the newest pipelines, their test report and the environments' deployments; plays a stage's manual jobs when its transition lets the version in, retries them for a run again or a roll back, and cancels them.

url.help: your GitLab server, when not https://gitlab.com

token.help: a project access token with the api scope

hosts: the GitLab server of the setting url
